rows.title: The INS front door's home becomes the overall notifications dashboard, with the performance suite's readiness probe following its heading
rows.detail: Today the front door's root page is a table of every notification with a reference search and a sort form. It becomes the service's home: a 'Dashboard' caption over the heading 'Import notification service', the 'Create new' button kept under it, then one section per notification category, each with a link into that category's own notification list in its own frontend. The performance suite checks the home's heading and models its reads, so the suite changes in the same increment as the heading and never before: changed first it breaks every performance run, changed late every run's readiness fails after five minutes. The home's per-category summary waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the front door's home sees a page whose main content is, in order, the caption, the heading, the 'Create new' button and one section per notification category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html, app/routes.js:11539-11545; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 8-9; trace:ins-fit trace-ins-fit-p4-005)

The home shows the caption 'Dashboard' directly above the h1 'Import notification service', while its browser title stays 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', so the heading and the title name the page independently of one another (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:23-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:14-16; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-002, p1-003)

Below the heading the home shows a 'Live animals' section then a 'Plants, plant products or other objects' section, each with an h2 heading and a 'View dashboard' link (trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 27-31; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:34-38)

Following the Live animals section's 'View dashboard' shows the live animals notification list at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:46-53; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p15-115)

The plants section's heading reads 'Plants, plant products or' with a line break before 'other objects', in the section's plants style, and following its 'View dashboard' shows the high-risk plants dashboard at the high-risk-plants set base on the plants frontend, reached at an address the front door reads from its own configuration so the link works in CDP, the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:100-131; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p15-117; ruling:sam-2026-11-04)

When the notification read model cannot be loaded, the home still shows its caption and heading, shows the service's recoverable error message, responds with HTTP status 500 and logs the failure; an error already shaped for the framework is passed on unchanged (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058)

With Welsh selected, the home's caption, heading, section headings, section links and glance-card copy show in Welsh, as do the Action needed, Status updated and Inspection required pages, each Welsh string recorded as a machine draft that does not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-086)
The home has no serious or critical axe violations against the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA tags (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-079)

The performance suite's check of the home requests '/' under the endpoint name 'ins-dashboard' and passes when the home answers 200 with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-001, repo-perftests-p2-003; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-004)

The performance suite models the home's load on the read model as the per-category count reads the home makes, and its check of how many notifications the read model holds reads that count from the read model (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-015, repo-perftests-p2-044; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-062)

The 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe passes when the home answers 200 to a signed-in trader with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, p3-076)
The 'address book read' readiness probe still passes when the front door's address book answers 200 with the heading 'Address book' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-041)

The stack counts as functionally ready only when one pass succeeds for all six readiness probes, and readiness otherwise fails after 300 seconds naming the probes that failed (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-042)

rows.title: The Action needed page lists the organisation's notifications needing action
rows.detail: Each category's Action needed glance card opens a page listing the notifications the trader must act on: a submitted notification still missing a required document, or with no animal identifier where one is required. The front door lists those notifications, across every category or only the one it is showing, scoped to the signed-in organisation, with an intro block, a results line, eight notifications a page and the same notification card the category list uses. A notification submitted with outstanding items keeps the status Submitted, which the drill-down shows as plain text rather than a tag, so this page, not its card, is where the trader sees that something is outstanding. It waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed, and until the outstanding-actions alert is designed and the animals backend records a notification's outstanding items again.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'View tasks' link opens a page at /actions whose browser title is 'Tasks requiring your attention - Import notification service - GOV.UK', showing the caption 'Action needed', the h1 'Tasks requiring your attention' and the description 'Add missing information or upload documents to prevent your consignment from being delayed.', the three together as one intro block styled to match the home's intro (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11708-11710, app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:34-36; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:153-159)

A live animals notification submitted without its ITAHC or health certificate is listed, its card showing the status as the plain text 'Submitted'; once the certificate is uploaded and the notification re-submitted, the page lists it no longer (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 14-16; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-084; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p15-087; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-004, p1-012)

A live animals notification submitted with its certificate but with a species that needs identifiers and none identified is listed; once one identifier is filled for each record, the page lists it no longer (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-149; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188)

The page lists only submitted notifications missing a required document or a required animal identifier, one identifier being enough for a record to count as identified: a draft notification, and a submitted one with every required document and identifier, are absent from it (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14)

A trader signed in for one organisation sees only that organisation's notifications on the page, and a fresh organisation with none sees 'Show 0 of 0 results' (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-068; trace:ins-fit trace-ins-fit-p4-046)

Opened with no category, the page lists action-needed notifications of every category; opened for live animals it lists only live-animals ones, a notification with no stored category counting as live animals; an unrecognised category lists every category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:6745-6747, 9027-9028; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:162-169)

The page's 'Back' link goes to the live animals notification list at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend while it is showing live animals, and to the home while it is showing every category or an unrecognised one (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:12-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:156, 167)

The list sits under a visually hidden h2 'Notifications needing action', preceded by 'Show 1-8 of <total> results', or 'Show 0 of 0 results' when there are none; with more than eight notifications the page shows eight at a time, and following a page link keeps the sort and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-89, app/routes.js:6630-6688, 9050; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:160-161)

Each listed notification is shown with the same notification card as the live animals list, whose content is the notification's reference, its facts, its status and the links its status gives it (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 15-16; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-030; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-007)

The page's main content holds only its intro block, its search and sort form, its results line and its list; opening it with a delay-filter query parameter shows the same list as opening it without one (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:9022-9023, 9043-9045)
The service navigation's 'Dashboard' item is marked current on the page (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8876, 9063; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-076)

With the front door's stub mode on, which is never on in production, the page lists the built-in stub's notifications; otherwise it reads them from the notification read model, and the read model's log for that read carries the page request's trace id (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-062, p1-063)

If the read model cannot be loaded the page still shows its intro, shows the recoverable error message, responds with HTTP status 500 and logs the failure; with Welsh selected its copy shows in Welsh, recorded as a machine draft; it has no serious or critical axe violations against the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA tags (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058, p1-079, p1-086)

rows.title: Search and sort the Action needed list
rows.detail: The Action needed page has a 'Search by' box and a 'Sort by:' select, and both are applied to the real list: the search matches a notification's number, commodity, consignee or consignor, and the sort is always applied, newest first when the page opens, with no unsorted state. The search and the sort are one form whose button submits them together, so the page works with JavaScript turned off. The field and parameter names are the service's own. It waits with the page it searches.
acceptanceCriteria: The Action needed page has its own search form with a 'Search by' field and the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'; a search made while the page is showing only live animals returns only live-animals notifications (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14, action 25)

Searching for part of a listed notification's number, its commodity, its consignee's name or its consignor's name lists only the notifications that match; a search typed with surrounding spaces finds the same notifications, and a blank search lists them all (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-015; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-081)
A search that matches nothing shows 'Show 0 of 0 results' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:7644-7658)

The 'Sort by:' select offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', with 'Newest first' selected when the page opens; choosing one and pressing the form's button re-orders the list to match, and changing the select on its own submits nothing, so the page works with JavaScript turned off (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-031)
The read model answers a search over a notification's consignee and consignor as well as its number and commodity (repo:tests repo-tests-p14-029)
Page links keep the chosen sort, the search text and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 25)
With Welsh selected, the search label, the hint, the sort label and the sort options show in Welsh, recorded as machine drafts (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-086)

rows.title: Action needed glance card on the home's Live animals section
rows.detail: The home summarises each category with glance cards. The Live animals section gets its Action needed card, counted from the same set of notifications its page lists for the signed-in organisation, so the count is real rather than a fixed number. A notification's category is the one the animals backend stores on its record, an absent one meaning live animals. It waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed, and with the rule that works out whether a notification has anything outstanding.

The Live animals section's only glance cards are 'Action needed' and 'Status updates' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:57-70; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 30)

rows.title: Status updates cards and the Status updated page
rows.detail: Each category gets a 'Status updates' card counting changes in the past 24 hours, opening a page that groups those notifications as Passed inspection, Needs inspection or Delayed. No service in the workspace receives inspection or delay outcomes and the INS read model holds no such state, so the cards and the page wait for the authorities' outcome feed rather than ship an always-empty page and a zero count. They also wait until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed.
acceptanceCriteria: The Live animals and Germinal products sections each show a 'Status updates' glance card reading 'Changes in the past 24 hours', its count in blue, with a 'View updates' link that opens the Status updated page showing only that category; each count equals the number of notifications that page lists for that category for the signed-in organisation (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:64-69, 73-98; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 35)

The 'View updates' link opens a page at /changes whose browser title is 'Changes in past 24 hours - Import notification service - GOV.UK', showing the caption 'Status updated', the h1 'Changes in past 24 hours' and the description 'Notifications that have progressed, or been validated, rejected, cancelled, or replaced in the past 24 hours.' together as one intro block styled to match the home's intro (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11712-11714, app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-changes.html:31-33; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:174-179)

rows.title: Inspection required page
rows.detail: An 'Inspection required' page lists the signed-in organisation's consignments chosen for inspection at the border control post, across every category, with guidance on what to do at a border inspection. No service in the workspace receives which notifications are chosen for inspection, so the page waits for the authorities' feed rather than ship a list that is always empty. It also waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed.

The page lists, under a visually hidden h2 'Notifications chosen for inspection', every one of the signed-in organisation's notifications chosen for inspection across all categories, each carrying whichever of the service's own statuses it now holds, including one whose status has moved on since it was chosen; opening the page with a category in the query lists the same notifications (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:6753-6755, 7442, 9094; trace:prototype-dr2-1 inspection-required snapshot 14; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-017)

The page has the same 'Search by' form and hint, 'Sort by:' select and 'Show <first>-<last> of <total> results' line as the Action needed page, shows eight notifications at a time, and its page links keep the sort (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-inspection.html:52-95, app/routes.js:6757-6807, 9108)

The page's main content holds only its intro block, the border-inspection details, its search and sort form, its results line and its list; the service navigation's 'Dashboard' item is marked current on it (trace:prototype-dr2-1 inspection-required snapshot 14; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-076)

The page shows the recoverable error message with HTTP status 500 when the read model cannot be loaded, shows its copy in Welsh with Welsh selected, recorded as a machine draft, and has no serious or critical axe violations (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058, p1-079, p1-086)

rows.title: Germinal products section on the home, and what makes a germinal notification need action
rows.detail: The home gets a Germinal products section, in a muted style, between Live animals and Plants, with its own View dashboard link to the germinal products list at the germinal products set root in the animals frontend, and its Action needed card. A germinal notification needs action on the same footing as a live animals one, worked out from the documents the germinal set asks for; that set asks for no animal identifier, so the identifier rule does not reach it. It waits until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed; its Status updates card waits with the Status updated page's count.
acceptanceCriteria: The home shows a 'Germinal products' section between 'Live animals' and 'Plants, plant products or other objects', in its muted style, with an h2 heading and a 'View dashboard' link that opens the germinal products notification list at the germinal products set root in the animals frontend (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:73-98; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 33, 36; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:42, 45)

The section shows an 'Action needed' card reading 'Tasks requiring your attention' with a count and a 'View tasks' link that opens the Action needed page showing only germinal products, and the section's only glance cards are 'Action needed' and 'Status updates' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8888-8894; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:45)

The germinal products Action needed count equals the number of results the Action needed page lists for germinal products for the signed-in organisation, and a live animals notification needing action is counted in the Live animals card instead (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-068)

A germinal products notification submitted while a document the germinal set asks for is still missing is counted on the Germinal products 'Action needed' card and listed on the Action needed page showing germinal products; one submitted with every document that set asks for is absent from both, whatever identifiers it holds (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-020; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-082)

Following the germinal products 'View tasks', the Action needed page's 'Back' link goes to the germinal products notification list at the germinal products set root in the animals frontend (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:12-24)

With Welsh selected the section's heading, link and card copy show in Welsh, recorded as machine drafts; the home still has no serious or critical axe violations (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-079, p1-086)
openQuestions: Blocked: Sam's 9 October rulings block the front door dashboard's summary information, naming the front door home's germinal section (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-061, c-297), until its requirements firm up and are agreed; the area is then re-distilled. Blocked: req-2193's germinal rule reads the rule that works out a notification's outstanding items, which Sam's 19 November ruling has the animals backend stop storing until the outstanding-actions alert of Sam's 16 November ruling arrives (c-417). Who: whoever designs that alert must design it, and whoever owns the animals backend must re-add the outstanding-items rule with it, for the germinal set's documents as well as live animals'.
notes: Carried over from the existing row unchanged: nothing behind it moved in this re-distil.

Depends on the live-animals glance-card row for the card pattern and the count, and on the germinal products set's own list at its set root (inc-141), which View dashboard and the Back link open (c-295). Completes req-971's three-section order, and observes req-975's germinal half and req-987's germinal Back-link half.
req-979 also names a germinal Status updates card; its count is req-977, blocked on the authorities' outcome feed, so that card is built with the blocked Status updated row (c-148).

req-2193 (c-366) sits here rather than in the Action needed page row because this row already builds the germinal card, its count and the germinal filter of that page, and already depends on the germinal set's own list. Its code is the drill-down's germinal filter and this card, both in the front door, so it is not a requirement to hand to a split-off theme's pickUp.

rows.title: The plants section's glance cards
rows.detail: The home's plants section shows three glance cards, linking into the same three pages the live animals and germinal products cards do, once plants notifications reach the INS read model. The cards and their counts wait on the plants services publishing to that read model, on the authorities' feeds behind two of the pages they open, and until the front door dashboard's requirements are firmed up and agreed.
acceptanceCriteria: The plants section shows three glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'View tasks' opening the Action needed page showing only plants, 'Status updates' with 'View updates' opening the Status updated page showing only plants, and 'Inspection required' reading 'Consignments due at the BCP' with 'View requirements' opening the Inspection required page (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:100-131; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:40, 46-48)
Each plants card's count equals the number of notifications its page lists for plants for the signed-in organisation (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-068)
The Status updates and Inspection required counts show in blue, and the Action needed count in the default count colour (trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 30)
